verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a Liveness & Face match check that confirms the applicant is a real, live person and matches them to the documents on file. Its documented spoof defenses explicitly cover deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks and photos of a screen, so screen attacks are covered and printed-photo attacks are covered only indirectly through 'paper mask'. Missing for 10: explicit documented defense against replayed video, explicit mention of printed-photo attacks, technical depth on anti-spoofing methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: In under a second, it confirms the applicant is a real, live person (not a deepfake, AI-generated image, paper mask, photo of a screen, or doll) and matches them to the account and documents on file.
Each level may include document-based or selfie-based verification, Liveness & Face match
In the profile, navigate to the Liveness section and review the results.
